purpose: Source attribution for existing implemented methods; no protocol/model modification and no novelty priority determination.
copyright: Paraphrased factual descriptions and citations only; no paper text, figures, datasets or model weights redistributed.
attribution_policy: Describe independently identified prior work as related prior work; do not invent a historical derivation or claim code reproduction.
Cite the actual reused dataset/formula/method separately from a related benchmark.
Do not compare reported accuracy without matching targets, cohorts, units and split definitions.
DFT-derived Tc and candidate model scores are not experimental discoveries.
KMeans/PCA/RBF similarities are not mechanisms, calibrated P(SC), or evidence of causal common laws.

model_routes.Storm6/7: Alexandria composition/geometry to simplified Allen-Dynes DFT Tc. S6 compares direct and predicted lambda/omega_log components with optional training-only PCA8. S7 adds16 train-only geometry KMeans-RBF features to unchanged S6R2; all challengers report-only.
model_routes.Hurricane4: Released route uses experimental-record classification/conditional Tc prediction plus distance-based abstention; background absence is not verified physical non-superconductivity. Screening averages five legal train-fold models; spread is descriptive.
model_routes.Hurricane7/8: Exploratory recorded-positive-descendant versus unlabeled-parent ranking. H7 uses pairwise Ridge/ElasticNet/PCA8 ablations. H8 adds16 train-only KMeans-RBF similarities to H7R0. Held family and its chemical systems are removed; no calibrated P(SC) or mechanism claim.
model_routes.Radar: Composition/structure classifier of 3DSC family-label routing proxy; not a direct mechanism determination or superconductivity detector.
model_routes.CGCNN-style graph branch: Periodic crystal graph gated-message architecture attributed to Xie/Grossman2018, independently implemented in JAX for electron-phonon targets; descriptor-hybrid variants are not a reproduction.
model_routes.MACE descriptor transfer: Frozen pretrained potential descriptors, not supervised superconductivity pretraining. H6M1 report-only and not adopted; checkpoint provenance must remain separate from current-paper versions.

selected_references.title: Clustering superconductors using unsupervised machine learning
selected_references.paper_did: Clusters superconductors using composition-based k-means, hierarchical and Gaussian-mixture methods, self-organizing maps and other clustering; discusses visualization and physically meaningful groupings.
selected_references.our_reuse: Uses the established idea of label-free material clustering to construct additional supervised-model inputs.
selected_references.our_differences: Our 16 KMeans centers are fitted only on eligible training physical features, then transformed into Gaussian RBF similarities. Storm7 uses geometry; H8 uses its allowed physical main effects. We test added predictive value against unchanged heads, not whether clusters prove mechanisms. No identical published implementation is claimed.
selected_references.attribution_timing: Related prior work identified in this retrospective audit; no claim that the original implementation was copied from or historically inspired by this paper.

selected_references.title: Deep learning model for finding new superconductors
selected_references.relationship: same-field extrapolation benchmark, not adopted architecture
selected_references.paper_did: Encodes compositions as a periodic-table representation and retrospectively tests whether pre-2008 data can retrieve later iron-based superconductors. Also proposes synthetic non-superconductor augmentation.
selected_references.our_reuse: Citation supports the existing research goal of testing discovery outside familiar training materials; no periodic-table CNN or synthetic-negative procedure is adopted here.
selected_references.our_differences: H7/H8 remove the held family and all of its chemical systems; earlier H4/Radar reports use family holdout. These are not the same temporal backtest. The inspected families are exploratory, not a new blind test. H7/H8 retain unlabeled parents as U, not verified negatives; neither test demonstrates an experimental discovery.
selected_references.attribution_timing: Related prior work identified in this retrospective audit; no claim that the original implementation was copied from or historically inspired by this paper.

selected_references.title: Designing high-TC superconductors with BCS-inspired screening, density functional theory, and deep-learning
selected_references.relationship: direct component-prediction precedent and JARVIS data context
selected_references.paper_did: Compares direct DFT Tc prediction, predicted lambda and omega_log followed by McMillan-Allen-Dynes, and predicted Eliashberg spectra. Uses ALIGNN and handcrafted CFID descriptors.
selected_references.our_reuse: Our direct-versus-components ablation follows an established route; predicting lambda/omega_log before Tc is not new.

selected_references.title: Machine learning of superconducting critical temperature from Eliashberg theory
selected_references.relationship: direct superconductivity leave-cluster-out precedent; theory benchmark, not formula adoption
selected_references.paper_did: Learns corrections to McMillan/Allen-Dynes from spectral moments and Eliashberg targets. Uses k-means-based leave-cluster-out validation and nested validation for predictive models.
selected_references.our_reuse: Cluster-held-out assessment of extrapolation already exists within superconductivity research.
selected_references.our_differences: Our chemically grouped/held-family tests differ from spectral-feature clusters; our inputs are composition/geometry and the Storm target remains simplified Allen-Dynes. selected_references.title: Transition temperature of strong-coupled superconductors reanalyzed
selected_references.relationship: direct physics-formula foundation; not an AI precedent
selected_references.paper_did: Derives an approximate Tc relation from Eliashberg theory including logarithmic phonon frequency and strong-coupling/shape corrections.
selected_references.our_reuse: Our lambda/omega_log-to-Tc calculation is a simplified Allen-Dynes expression, with fixed mu*=0.10 and correction factors f1=f2=1.
selected_references.our_differences: We do not implement the complete strong-coupling corrections or solve Eliashberg equations. Those approximations define the DFT-derived target; they are not experimental measurements or a new learned law.

selected_references.title: Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks for an Accurate and Interpretable Prediction of Material Properties
selected_references.relationship: direct architecture attribution; general crystal-property ML, not a superconductivity-discovery paper
selected_references.paper_did: Introduces periodic crystal graphs, convolutional updates from neighboring atoms/bonds, gated nonlinear message functions and pooled crystal representations for DFT-property prediction.
selected_references.our_reuse: The local source explicitly identifies its architecture as CGCNN-style. It uses gated message passing and pooling on periodic crystal graphs.
selected_references.our_differences: Our JAX implementation restricts each atom to 12 nearest neighbors within 8 angstrom, uses Gaussian edge distances and supervised electron-phonon targets. Later hybrid variants add composition/structure/physics descriptors to the readout. This is an adaptation, not a reproduction of their code, benchmark or claimed accuracy; these settings are not asserted to be uniquely novel.
selected_references.attribution_timing: Already explicitly cited in ml/gnn.py before this audit; source and local reuse independently checked now.

disclosure_gaps: No exact superconductivity paper for this particular16-prototype Gaussian-RBF augmentation was established; do not infer originality from this limited search.

No direct prior reproduction of the exact Radar learned routing label was established; cite Stanev as related family-specific classification/regression and Sommer as actual dataset, not as the inventor of this exact router.
No superconductivity-specific split-conformal guarantee was verified here; cite Lei as general statistics and report measured group/row coverage with distribution-shift limitations.
This12-reference audit includes CGCNN and MACE but does not replace existing gradient-boosting, scikit-learn, Alexandria and other dataset/software citations. Keep those existing citations.

ui_guidance.KMeans/PCA: Related prior work: Roter et al.(2022) and Roter & Dordevic(2020). Our comparison uses train-only physical representations and unchanged supervised baselines; similarity is not mechanism.
ui_guidance.component_route: Related prior work: Choudhary & Garrity(2022); formula: Allen & Dynes(1975). We compare direct versus predicted-component routes on DFT-derived targets.
ui_guidance.validation: Chemical-system separation follows established materials benchmarks including3DSC; family/cluster extrapolation is discussed by Konno(2021) and Xie et al.(2022). Reused families are exploratory.
ui_guidance.uncertainty: Fold disagreement and split-conformal intervals are different quantities. Cite ensemble precedent separately from the statistical interval method.
